description: Agent Firewall: check untrusted text, HTML or a URL for prompt injection before your model reads it. Finds hidden text, invisible Unicode and ASCII smuggling, role spoofing, instructions aimed at AI, secret or data exfiltration, payment hijacks and tool-call injection; returns a risk score, findings and a sanitized copy. $0.004 per text check, $0.006 per URL. Costs $0.006 USDC per call (x402).

deep.description: Also ask a model to judge intent (default true)

mode.description: strip (default) removes flagged sentences from the sanitized copy; flag only reports
